title: Incentives to Build Houses, Trade Houses, or Trade House Building Skills in Simulated Worlds under Various Governing Systems or Institutions: Comparing Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning to Generative Agent-based Model
reasoning: The paper explicitly models agent morality using inequity aversion coefficients and evaluates the impact of different governing systems, such as Utilitarianism, on agent morality, fairness, and equality. It uses a generative agent-based model (GABM) framework which involves LLMs as agents.
